title: P2 Mastery Expansion: Complete 10-Skill Foundation Stage Pool
description: 100 themed Primary 2 exercises (10 per CCEA Foundation Stage skill) spanning CCVC/CVCC, digraphs, double letters, target vowels, decodable captions, Double Ten-Frames 11–20, bonds to 10, +/- within 20, UK coins to 20p, and 3D shapes.

exercises.subject: literacy

prompt.text: Blend the sounds together to find "frog"!

hint.text: Tap each sound box from left to right: f - r - o - g.

feedback.correctText: Super blending! f-r-o-g makes "frog"!
feedback.encourageText: Almost! Slide your finger across the sounds and listen again.

exercises.offlineParentTip: Practise 'robot talk' with 4-sound words at dinner (e.g. 'f-o-r-k' or 'm-i-l-k') and let your child blend the robot's sounds into the real word.

prompt.text: How many stars are on the double Ten-Frame?

hint.text: The first frame is a full 10 — count on from 10 to find the total.

feedback.correctText: Brilliant counting! There are 11 stars!
feedback.encourageText: Almost! Tap each star to count one by one.

exercises.offlineParentTip: Bundle 10 lollipop sticks or straws with an elastic band to make '1 ten', then add loose ones beside it to build teen numbers like 14 (1 ten and 4 ones).
